name: info
content: Connect your Google Health account (Fitbit / Pixel data). You'll need a Google Cloud project with the **Google Health API** enabled and an OAuth client. See the plugin help for step-by-step setup.

name: oauth2ClientId
label: Google OAuth client ID
help: The OAuth 2.0 client ID from your Google Cloud project (APIs & Services → Credentials).

name: oauth2ClientSecret
label: Google OAuth client secret
help: The OAuth 2.0 client secret that pairs with the client ID above.

name: goalsHeader
content:
---
### Daily goals
Set your personal targets. Gauges fill towards these and their health status (green / amber / red) is measured against them. Leave blank to use the defaults shown.

name: distanceGoal
label: Distance goal (km)
help: Target distance per day, in kilometres.

name: activeCalorieGoal
label: Active calories goal
help: Target active calories burned per day.

name: zoneMinutesGoal
label: Active zone minutes goal
help: Target active zone minutes per day.

name: waterGoal
label: Water goal (mL)
help: Target water intake per day, in millilitres.

name: calorieBudget
label: Calorie budget (kcal)
help: Daily calorie intake budget. Gauge is green while at or under this.

name: proteinGoal
label: Protein goal (g)
help: Target protein per day, in grams.
